sentences.text: The type species, Sinraptor dongi, stood nearly 3 meters tall and measured roughly 7.6 meters in length.
This animal is estimated to have weighed 1 ton.
Despite its name, Sinraptor is not a dromaeosaurid like Velociraptor but is a carnosaur distantly related to Allosaurus.
According to Holtz, the second species Sinraptor hepingensis was larger, measuring 8.84 meters in length.
A massive tooth measuring 10 centimeters in length was found at the same site as Sinraptor and may have belonged to the animal.
In 2016, researchers suggested the holotype was a subadult and estimated an adult Sinraptor could reach 11.5 meters in length and 3.9 tons in weight.
The holotype of Sinraptor was discovered in 1987 during a joint Chinese-Canadian expedition in the northwestern Chinese desert and formally described in 1994 by Philip J. Currie and Zhao Xijin.
The holotype was found in the Shishugou Formation by Philip J. Currie and Xian Zhao during a 1987 Chinese-Canadian expedition in the northwestern Chinese desert.
Sinraptor dongi was found in the Shishugou Formation in Xinjiang, China, while Sinraptor hepingensis was found in the Shangshaximiao Formation in Sichuan, China.
The skull of Sinraptor is estimated to be 90 centimeters in length.
Sinraptor likely preyed on medium-sized dinosaurs like stegosaurs using its blade-like teeth to inflict fatal wounds.
A Sinraptor skull specimen shows evidence of healed injuries, including tooth drags, punctures, and a fully penetrating lesion.
A Sinraptor rib was broken and healed through a process called telescoping of its shaft.
Sinraptor lived during the Late Jurassic period, specifically the Oxfordian stage.
Sinraptor lived 161 million years ago during the Oxfordian stage of the Late Jurassic in what is now Asia.
The classification of Sinraptor hepingensis is debated, with some researchers including it in Yangchuanosaurus based on a 2024 phylogenetic analysis.
